Scope and missing dates

The 45 included papers retain the review database's years. Five records differ from the verified citation registry; see the methods. References without a reliable year remain in an undated lane.

Reference identities were matched conservatively using identifiers and title/year evidence. Bibliographic versions may remain separate; the count is a reconstruction, not a global citation metric.
